issue.title: Record decisions:off-clock-links-are-uncapped after reviewer declined it for 202611/off_clock_links_uncapped

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add decisions strand decisions:off-clock-links-are-uncapped, modeled on decisions:off-clock-follows-tag-then-note-default. Applies to: the bob-cli plan budget, bob-ledger-tools, and Bob Mac Capture (through plan_budget). Claim: a Task Link whose task resolves off-clock never counts toward plan.max_links; it stays a Today task; unresolved links stay counted. Why: the user asked for it: off-clock life should not use up the daily focus budget. Rejected alternatives: dropping off-clock tasks from Today (it pushes them into NEXT/PENDING sections and removes the marks); exempting by session name the way PLAN is exempted (the clock is per task, not per session); a separate off-clock cap (not requested). Cost: the budget now needs vault resolution in both engines; uncached targets briefly count in Obsidian. Reopens when: off-clock work needs a cap of its own. Evidence: plan 202611/off_clock_links_uncapped.md; link [[decisions:off-clock-follows-tag-then-note-default]].

issue.creation_reason: Reviewer set decision_record=no for the approved off-clock-links-uncapped plan; the decisions strand was never written, so file the declined record per the memory-write declined-change rule.
